## Description

Formulates institutional order liquidation trajectory optimization (minimizing market impact and timing risk) into a QUBO problem solved on quantum annealing hardware.

## Where it may fit

Large institutional block trades, multi-asset portfolio liquidations under high market impact.

## Vehicles

Institutional agency execution desks, algorithmic trading brokerages.

## Required data

Order book depth profiles, historical volume participation curves, temporary/permanent impact coefficients.

## Caveats

Requires formulation mapping to quantum annealer qubit connectivity constraints and penalty weight tuning.
